label: RESEARCH_EVIDENCE — retrospective calibration evaluation. NOT a market verdict, NOT validation, NOT a promotion input.
family: MLB batter props challenger (Model Fix Lane, family 1)

challenger.construction: P(v) = (count_H(v) + K * L_s(d)(v)) / (n + K), K=25; H = ALL same-season prior games PA>=1 (no 30-game cap); L = expanding season-to-date empirical distribution over all starting batters' prior games (Phase 2 B2 construction)

parity.comparison_scope: evaluator pool (production collector semantics, prereg section 2) vs production MLBBatterPublicSource.prior_games pa_history, exact list-of-dicts equality. Sealed window declared not applicable to 2026 (prereg section 4).

n_zero_cannot_occur.note: fixture eligibility requires the production pool gates (>=10 games, >=20 PA) on the <=30-game pool; the uncapped history H is a superset, so n >= 10 for every scored fixture; asserted again in the scoring loop.

population.exclusion_reason_precedence: NOT_A_STARTER -> POOL_GAMES_LT_10 -> POOL_PA_LT_20 (prereg section 4 transposing Phase 2; sealed window not applicable)
population.universe_note: Universe = gameLog rows (PA>=1 parse, as production retains) matched to regular-season schedule games; boxscore batting appearances with no gameLog row are counted separately and enter neither fixtures nor NOT_A_STARTER.

baseline_implementations.note: B1/B2 exactly as implemented in Phase 2 eval_batter_props.py (raw uncapped empirical frequency/distribution; B1 dedups by gamePk, no doubleheader re-selection). Implementing lines quoted verbatim:

conventions: CHALLENGER_CRPS: computed from the challenger PMF via E|X-y| - 0.5*E|X-X'|, unit-checked to agree with Phase 2's crps_from_counter on empirical PMFs to <1e-12.
CHALLENGER_N: per-stat n = number of uncapped prior games with a recorded value for that stat (equals |H| whenever the stat field is present, as in production rows).
CALIBRATION_BINS: ten equal-width bins [0,0.1)...[0.9,1.0], as Phase 2.

bootstrap.blocks: ISO calendar weeks of fixture date

BATTER_HOME_RUNS.threshold_brier_note: Brier at 0.5/1.5 descriptive; gate is CRPS-only per prereg section 6.

BATTER_EXTRA_BASE_HITS.threshold_brier_note: Brier at 0.5/1.5 descriptive; gate is CRPS-only per prereg section 6.

BATTER_TRIPLES.threshold_brier_note: Brier at 0.5/1.5 descriptive; gate is CRPS-only per prereg section 6.

BATTER_STRIKEOUTS.threshold_brier_note: Brier at 0.5/1.5 descriptive; gate is CRPS-only per prereg section 6.

BATTER_RUNS_RBIS.threshold_brier_note: Brier at 0.5/1.5 descriptive; gate is CRPS-only per prereg section 6.
